usageNotes: Returns the cluster-level Ceph API index — a list of child resource names (e.g. 'config', 'status', 'osd', 'pools') available under /cluster/ceph. Use this as a discovery call to confirm which Ceph sub-resources are exposed before drilling into them. No Ceph cluster needs to be configured for this call to succeed; it returns the static index regardless.
tips: The returned 'name' values in each item correspond to child endpoints under /cluster/ceph/{name} — use them to discover valid follow-up calls.
This endpoint requires only the 'all' permission (any authenticated user or API token can call it), making it safe for read-only monitoring tokens.
Prefer node-level /nodes/{node}/ceph/* endpoints for operational Ceph management (OSD add/remove, pool create, etc.); this cluster-level index is navigation only.
